error.discovery_error_reply: The switcher rejected the port request: {reply}
error.no_free_port: No free connection channel on the switcher (the control panel + up to 3 PCs). Close other apps; if you just disconnected, wait a few seconds and try again. If it persists, the switcher may be holding stale channels and needs a restart.

log.closed_with_stats: Connection closed (unexpected null packets on the command channel: {nulls_received})
log.silent: No packets from the switcher on the {channel} channel for 3 seconds - treating the connection as lost
log.bad_frame: Corrupted packet on the {channel} channel ({error}) - closing the connection
log.handler_error: Unexpected error while handling a {channel} packet - closing the connection
